intro.title: Rooted here. Made to be shared.
body: Texoma Collective brings together the people, places, businesses and stories that make Lake Texoma worth experiencing.

We market businesses, grow businesses and tell the stories that make people fall in love with Texoma - creating a stronger community, a vibrant local economy and a brighter future for the lake we call home.

about.eyebrow: A place. A connection. A story.
about.title: The people behind a stronger Texoma.
about.intro: We are lake lovers, parents, storytellers and industry leaders who have called Lake Texoma home for decades.
body: Our experience in tourism, hospitality, marketing and events gives us a deep understanding of this place and the businesses that keep it thriving.
Texoma Collective brings that knowledge together with a shared passion: telling the stories of our lake, championing its people and helping others discover what makes this community worth knowing.

items.a: Texoma Collective is the tourism, marketing, events and sales organization connecting Lake Texoma's visitors, businesses, places and stories.

items.q: Is Texoma Collective a booking site?
items.a: No. Stays and experiences are booked through the participating business or Texoma Destinations. Texoma Collective helps people discover and connect.
The partner network is designed for tourism-facing businesses and organizations across the Lake Texoma region in Texas and Oklahoma.

items.q: Can the team help with a group or event?
items.a: Yes. Use the group and event inquiry option to start a conversation about your plans.
